title: Tribes influence upper bound
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers with $w>0$, and let $J$ be any set of coordinates in the sign cube of dimension $sw$. For the tribes function with $s$ blocks of width $w$, its coalitional influence toward $1$ on $J$ is at most $|J|2^{-w}$.
hypotheses_covered: A set $J$ of coordinates in dimension $sw$
